name: The Ninth Doctor
oracle_text:
Haste
Into the TARDIS — Whenever The Ninth Doctor becomes untapped during your untap step, you get an additional upkeep step after this step.
blocked_sentences: Into the TARDIS — Whenever The Ninth Doctor becomes untapped during your untap step, you get an additional upkeep step after this step.

needs.what: an op that inserts one additional upkeep step for the controller directly after the current step (500.8), so upkeep triggers fire again, without adding an untap or draw step
needs.why_existing_wont_do: extra_beginning_phase adds a whole beginning phase (untap, upkeep and draw), which would untap permanents and draw an extra card; extra_combat and extra_turn are other turn structures; no op adds a single step

needs.what: a becomes_untapped trigger restricted to the untap performed by your untap step (the trigger then goes on the stack in the following upkeep, so 'after this step' is after that upkeep)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: becomes_untapped exists, but no trigger key narrows it to the untap step's untap; step_is is a condition key with no documented untap-step value, and the untap step grants no priority so the engine's handling of triggers there is unconfirmed
